capabilities: Draw a lifespan grid in day, week or month units
Compute life expectancy from WHO data with lifestyle adjustments
Link existing notes to dates and create notes from grid cells
Show stats on life lived and a color legend
extras: The directory entry notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README includes a medical disclaimer that lifestyle adjustments are rough population averages, not a forecast, and no network access is needed since WHO data is bundled.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in view that shows your whole life as a dated grid or connects daily, weekly and monthly notes to cells in such a grid.
summary: Life-grid view that draws your lifespan as a grid of days, weeks or months, colored by lived time against WHO life expectancy.
